system_prompt_style.note: The bundled repo is github/codeql (the analysed tool), not the ARQ harness. No prompt-construction code or prompt text is available.

env_context_strategy.note: The paper delegates to external coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity). ARQ has no task template or tool list in the evidence.

context_compaction.note: No ARQ harness code is present, so there is no place to check for history processing.

tool_call_format.note: Tool calling is handled by the underlying commercial agents. ARQ has no parser in the evidence.

tool_count.note: The paper mentions task-specific tools (CodeQL, sanitizers, LSP via MCP) but does not enumerate them.

edit_primitive.note: Editing is done by the external coding agents. No ARQ edit tool is described.

tool_schema_source.note: No tool schema source is available.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: context Protocol (Wang et al. 2026) to help with grammar.
protocol_standardization.note: CodeQL LSP is exposed to the agent through Model Context Protocol during Improve. Evidence is paper-only.

loop_primitives.note: Witness generation, then Analyze/Oracle validation, then Improve, then regression re-check, iterated T times (Algorithm 1). Paper-only.

planning_granularity.note: A fixed algorithmic recipe is given to the agent. No plan object is stored.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: we delegated Algorithm 1 to coding agents.
multi_agent_topology.note: Each run uses one commercial coding agent executing the whole algorithm. Sec. 3.3 speaks of delegating Gen/Improve/Analyze/Oracle to agents; the topology is unclear.

delegation_mechanism.note: The delegation mechanism is not described.

human_in_loop.note: No HITL configuration surface is available.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: A regression setWr stores every witnessn validated
short_term_state.note: The regression witness set Wr is maintained across iterations.

long_term_memory.note: Paper only; no memory configuration is available.

self_verification.evidence_quote: Re-run Q1 on every witness: accept or roll back
self_verification.note: Execution-grounded validation: CodeQL Analyze plus sanitizer Oracle on synthesized programs. Syntax errors from the compiler/LSP are also reported.

retry_policy.note: Witness generation also has budget N. The paper notes the budget may be a time limit instead.

rollback.note: Closest-value choice: the refinement rolls back to the previous query version, which is an artifact-level revert rather than a filesystem snapshot.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: Each query in § 4.1 was refined over 5 iterations, each
termination_condition.note: T iterations cap; a 25-minute per-iteration timeout also applies.

cost_controls.note: Thinking level was lowered to reduce cost. No budget mechanism is described.

timeouts.note: The time budget applies per refinement iteration.

execution_isolation.note: The execution environment of the agents is not described.

tracing.note: Agent transcripts are mentioned, but ARQ has no tracing facility in the evidence.

eval_hooks.note: The Juliet/FormAI evaluation is described, but no ARQ repo is available.

target_domain.evidence_quote: automatically refines C/C++ CodeQL queries using execution-
target_domain.note: The domain is static-analysis query refinement for vulnerability detection; swe is the closest value.

open_source.note: The MIT licence in the bundle belongs to github/codeql, not ARQ. No ARQ code release is stated.

model_agnostic.note: Portability comes from swapping vendor coding agents, not from an abstraction layer.

primary_artifact.note: The linked repo is the CodeQL query library the system refines, not ARQ's code.

pinned_version.note: The bundle ref codeql-cli/v2.26.4 @1d123a2caa0e pins CodeQL, not ARQ. The paper used CodeQL v2.23.1 queries.

stars.note: The 10105 stars are for github/codeql, not ARQ.
